snippet.title: Best Guess Live | Official Game Trailer | Netflix
snippet.description:
Play Best Guess Live, the new Netflix mobile game show, for a chance to win a portion of $15,000. Solve 5 clues, submit the right answer, and you could win big!

Participation open to legal residents of the 50 United States and D.C., 18+. Void where prohibited. Access to a Netflix account and a PayPal account required for participation and prize fulfillment. “Best Guess Live” is a skill-based game. Official Terms & Conditions at https://bit.ly/BestGuessLive. Sponsor: Netflix, Inc.

Subscribe: https://bit.ly/3Rw25E1

About Netflix Games: 
Netflix Games is part of your Netflix membership. No ads, no extra fees, no in-app purchases. Just unlimited access to exclusive mobile games you can play anytime, anywhere. With over 300 million members in 190+ countries, Netflix is bringing stories to life across TV, film, and games. Now you can play them, too.
